scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @velarscript/compiler && npm run build --workspace @velarscript/node && npm run build --workspace @velarscript/web && npm run build --workspace create-velar && npm run build --workspace @velarscript/desktop && npm run build --workspace @velarscript/cli
scripts.check: npm run build:packages && npm run check:format && npm run check:docs && npm run check:boundaries && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-timeout=120000 tests/*.test.ts tests/ci.acceptance.ts tests/release.acceptance.ts && node packages/cli/src/cli.ts check examples/production-web && node packages/cli/src/cli.ts check examples/flow-board && node packages/cli/src/cli.ts check examples/support-desk && node packages/cli/src/cli.ts check examples/api-dashboard && node packages/cli/src/cli.ts test examples/production-web && node packages/cli/src/cli.ts test examples/flow-board && node packages/cli/src/cli.ts test examples/support-desk && node packages/cli/src/cli.ts test examples/api-dashboard
scripts.test:browser: npm run build:packages && node tests/browser.acceptance.ts && node packages/cli/src/cli.ts test examples/production-web --browser all && node packages/cli/src/cli.ts test examples/flow-board --browser all && node packages/cli/src/cli.ts test examples/support-desk --browser all && node packages/cli/src/cli.ts test examples/api-dashboard --browser all && node tests/installed-browser.acceptance.ts
